name: 東京ドーム
notes: Draft parent-block template for Tokyo Dome concert seat maps.
Coordinates are normalized in a 1:1 square seat-map space.
Detailed Tokyo Dome seats should be added as seatZones inside these parent blocks.
Arena seating is temporary and should be treated as approximate for live events.
